tagline: I explain your paperwork in simple words.

home.hint: Take a photo of your bill, letter or notice, and I'll tell you what it is and what to do.

access.title: Welcome
access.label: Enter the family code
access.wrong: That code isn't right. Ask your son for it.
access.error: I couldn't check the code. Please try again in a moment.

photo.readingHint: This can take up to a minute. Please keep the screen open.
photo.errorNetwork: I couldn't connect. Check your internet and try again.
photo.errorTooBig: The photo is too large. Please try taking it again.
photo.errorType: That file isn't a photo. Use the "Take photo" button.
photo.errorGeneric: I couldn't read the photo right now. Please try again later.

result.fraudTitle: Careful! This might be a scam
result.fraudNever: Never give out passwords, PINs, card numbers or personal information.
result.lowConfidenceTitle: I couldn't read your paper well
result.noAmount: I didn't find an amount to pay.
result.whatToDo: What do I need to do?
result.nothingToDo: For now, you don't need to do anything.
result.disclaimer: I only explain the paper; this is not legal or financial advice. If it's something serious, talk it over with your son or a professional.

history.title: My papers
history.empty: There are no papers yet. Take a photo to get started.

voice.title: Ask me with your voice
voice.aboutDocument: Your question is about this paper:
voice.hint: Tap the button, ask your question, then tap "I'm done".
voice.listeningHint: This can take up to a minute.
voice.errorPermission: I need permission to use the microphone. Tap "Allow" when the phone asks you.
voice.errorUnsupported: This phone won't let me record. Ask your son for help.
voice.errorAudio: I couldn't hear the recording. Please try again.
